name: Wyoming Jackalope Dash 2018

venue.name: [College Heights Baptist Church](https://www.collegeheightscasper.org/)
venue.details: Parking lots are south of the building. The competition is in the large sanctuary/gym on the east side of the building.

information:
There is a competitor limit of 80 competitors, so make sure to register while spots are open.
This is the first competition to be held in Wyoming!
You must pay the registration fee in full to complete the registration process.
